chunks: 3205 - And he, peace be upon him, said:

"When you consume it, then say: O Allah, Lord of the blessed soil and Lord of the Wasi whom it has covered, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and make it beneficial knowledge, abundant sustenance, and a cure from every illness."

key_terms.التُّرْبَةِ الْمُبَارَكَةِ: the blessed soil, referring to the sanctified soil connected to Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام
key_terms.الْوَصِيِّ: the designated successor, here referring to the Imam buried in that soil
key_terms.صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ: send blessings upon Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and his family as part of the supplication

ai.seo_question: What supplication should be recited when consuming the blessed soil of Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a specific du'a to be recited when consuming the blessed soil, invoking Allah through its sanctity and through the Wasi buried within it. The supplication asks for spiritual and worldly benefit: beneficial knowledge, expansive provision, and healing from illness.
